name: Rust Monster

actions.name: Antennae
actions.effect: Touches one non-magical metal object or weapon. The object corrodes: armor loses 2 defense permanently, weapons deal -1d6 damage permanently. Fully corroded items are destroyed.

reactions.name: Rust Touch
reactions.effect: When hit by a non-magical metal melee weapon, the Rust Monster corrodes the weapon. The weapon permanently deals -1d6 damage.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.desc: Can smell metal within 30m. Knows exact location of all metal objects and creatures wearing metal armor.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.desc: Any non-magical metal that touches the Rust Monster corrodes. Magical metal items are immune.

lore: Rust Monsters are the bane of armored warriors, insectoid creatures that feed on metal by corroding it with their antennae. They are not aggressive by nature, but their insatiable appetite for iron and steel makes them dreaded by any adventurer in metal gear.
